name: cell_url_fields
expr: (lambda en: [(r,c,t.TextField.URL,t.TextField.Representation) for sh in [doc.Sheets.getByIndex(0)] for r in range(110) for c in range(11) for p in en(sh.getCellByPosition(c,r).Text.createEnumeration()) for t in en(p.createEnumeration()) if t.TextPortionType=='TextField'])(lambda e:[e.nextElement() for _ in iter(e.hasMoreElements, False)])
